records.command:
rg -n 'totalVideos|waiting|queued|ready|job.projectId' classic/apps/web/src/batch/automation-progress.tsx classic/apps/web/src/batch/provider.tsx
sed -n '198,238p' classic/apps/web/src/batch/automation-progress.tsx
sed -n '440,495p' classic/apps/web/src/batch/provider.tsx
rg -n 'preview.*framing|FullAuto' crates/editor-api/tests/fixtures/classic-project.json | head -2
sed -n '195,220p' classic/apps/web/src/core/managers/project-manager.ts

rg -n 'totalVideos|waiting|queued|ready|job.projectId' classic/apps/web/src/batch/automation-progress.tsx classic/apps/web/src/batch/provider.tsx
sed -n '198,238p' classic/apps/web/src/batch/automation-progress.tsx
sed -n '440,495p' classic/apps/web/src/batch/provider.tsx
rg -n 'preview.*framing|FullAuto' crates/editor-api/tests/fixtures/classic-project.json | head -2
sed -n '195,220p' classic/apps/web/src/core/managers/project-manager.ts

python3 - <<'PY'
p='classic/apps/web/src/batch/progress-view.ts';s=open(p).read().replace('totalVideos: entries.length,','totalVideos: entries.length,\n\t\twaiting: entries.filter(e=>["queued","ready"].includes(e.job.status)&&e.run.id!==state.executionRunId).length,');open(p,'w').write(s)
p='classic/apps/web/src/batch/automation-progress.tsx';s=open(p).read().replace('{view.totalVideos} videos ready','{view.totalVideos} videos ready');# inspect actual variable next
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='classic/apps/web/src/batch/provider.tsx';s=open(p).read().replace('href={`/editor/${job.projectId}`}','href={`/editor/${job.sourceProjectId ?? job.projectId}`}');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
rustfmt --edition 2024 --config skip_children=true crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_automation.rs crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_settings.rs
cargo check -q -p opencut-editor-api
